binary_label: raw levels 0-1 = low; raw levels 2-3 = high
calibration: none; the OOF logistic stacker is the only probability-combination model
cross_task_inner_validation: two balanced recording-disjoint folds; one low and one high recording in each validation fold
excluded_channels: all accelerometer, marker, packet-status, counter and other auxiliary columns
loso_inner: complete leave-one-subject-out over the outer training subjects

risk_gate.claim_scope: risk-aware empirical gate; no CVaR optimisation, constraint or guarantee

stacker.sample_weight: inverse number of windows in each recording

primary_estimand: paired mean subject-level accuracy difference: risk_aware minus always_nn
recording_aggregation: geometric mean of window probabilities, then argmax
seed_aggregation: per-class median probability at window level
tail_metrics: exploratory only because n=15 is inadequate for stable CVaR10 estimation
